definitions.explanation: A gate or barrier at airports, train stations, stadiums, or other facilities that controls entry and exit.

examples.japanese: {搭乗|とうじょう}ゲートに{向|む}かう。
examples.english: I head to the boarding gate.

examples.japanese: ゲートが{開|あ}くまで{待|ま}ってください。
examples.english: Please wait until the gate opens.

examples.japanese: {空港|くうこう}の{搭乗|とうじょう}ゲートが{変更|へんこう}になったので、{急|いそ}いで{移動|いどう}した。
examples.english: The boarding gate at the airport was changed, so I hurried to the new one.

notes:
ゲート comes from English "gate" and is used primarily for controlled entry/exit points at facilities.

COMPOUNDS:
- {搭乗|とうじょう}ゲート: boarding gate (airport)
- {改札|かいさつ}ゲート: ticket gate (train station)
- {入場|にゅうじょう}ゲート: entrance gate
- スタートゲート: starting gate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {門|もん}: gate (traditional, for buildings, temples, etc.)
- {改札|かいさつ}: ticket gate (at train stations, more common than ゲート in this context)
- ゲート is typically used for modern facilities like airports and stadiums, while {門|もん} is for traditional architecture.
